dedupe_keys.name: joint research centre dams and flood defences datasets

description: Joint Research Centre: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Joint Research Centre, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Joint Research Centre. Coverage: Joint Research Centre. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Dam break scenarios for Turano and Salto dams, Italy (2024-03-13); Dam break simulation, Iraq (2022-04-12); EFAS estimated flood protection level; Risk of failure of the Ituango Dam in Colombia (2018-05-22). Formats seen: WMS, ZIP, GDB, HTML, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is European Commission reuse notice, CC-BY-4.0, as linked on the portal listing (http://data.jrc.ec.europa.eu/licence/not_available). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-jrc.
